newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle limited test at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle limited test at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 500 heifers; 29,500 head confirmed for the week to date including 21,000 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.

Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.00 Select, few Choice 1050-1150 lbs 63.75. Confirmed - 700
